gloss: to compete against; to play against; to face (an opponent)

definitions.gloss: to compete against; to play against; to face (an opponent)
definitions.explanation: To engage in a match or battle against an opponent, whether in sports, games, or other competitive contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対戦|たいせん}した。
examples.english: We played against a strong team.
Who will you face in the next match?

examples.japanese: ⟦{決勝戦|けっしょうせん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対戦|たいせん}することになった。
examples.english: We ended up facing last year's championship team in the final.

notes:
Used broadly for any competitive matchup — sports, board games, video games, card games, martial arts, etc. The noun form ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧ is also very common on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{対戦|たいせん}{相手|あいて}→対戦相手：29381_taisenaite⟧: opponent
- ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧: head-to-head record
- ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧: online match
- ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧: match schedule; bracket
- ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: matchup card

USAGE:
The particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ marks the opponent: A⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{対戦|たいせん}する (A plays against B). Also frequently used as a noun modifier: ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (competitive game), ⟦{対戦|たいせん}→対戦：15338_taisen⟧⟦{形式|けいしき}→形式：00211_keishiki⟧ (versus format).
